new_theorem.statement: For rank-two physical hub/star A[H,I]=P C^T with P^TP=I2, G=C^TC, Z=C G^{-1/2}, row leverages ell_k, and partner aggregate G_*, if max ell_k<=1-delta then D=A[I,I]=Lambda+Z R Z^T+T with Lambda diagonal, R symmetric 2x2, and ||T||_F<=4 sqrt(G_*/(delta det G)). If max ell_k<1, G_*=0 iff T=0, i.e. D is diagonal plus aligned rank two.
new_theorem.coloop_note: ell_k=1 iff deleting physical row k drops the rank-two partner plane; at most two such rows.

obstruction.statement: With two literal hubs, flat orthonormal u,v, cross scale 2, and D=uu^T-vv^T, all four active eigenvalues have modulus >1 while every whitened leaf leverage is 2/m and G_*=0. Adding hub edge epsilon preserves |lambda|>1 for |epsilon|<=1/2 by Weyl. This refutes only the structural implication that the target forces positive/universal G_*, not QFORM.

applied_results.mixed_hub: For 2Xa<u,Y>+2Xb<v,Y>+lambda<w,Y>^2 with flat orthonormal u,v,w, pinned Theorem H gives ||p||_infty <= (5/3)2^(6/5)|lambda|^(-1/5) and the same linear interval bound.
applied_results.partner: For D=uu^T-vv^T+lambda ww^T at cross scale 2, G_*=16 lambda^2(1-3/m); for Walsh m>=32 the latest account03/B09 diffuse gate applies and gives ||p||_infty <5.278 |lambda|^(-1/3)(1-3/m)^(-1/6).
